method: breaths by loudness (under -20 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 23 of 34 breaks heard

lines.latin: Te Matrem laudámus: te Dóminam confitémur.
lines.english: We praise thee as Mother: we acknowledge thee to be our Lady.

lines.latin: Te ætérni Patris stella maris splendor illúminat.
lines.english: Thee, star of the sea, the splendour of the eternal Father enlightens.

lines.latin: Tibi omnes Ángeli, tibi cæli et univérsæ potestátes:
lines.english: To thee all the Angels, to thee the heavens and all the Powers,

lines.latin: Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim incessábili voce proclámant:
lines.english: to thee the Cherubim and Seraphim cry out with unceasing voice:
Virgin, Virgin,
Virgin of virgins without equal.

lines.latin: Ante partum et in partu atque post partum.
lines.english: before childbirth, in childbirth, and after childbirth.
Thee, the glorious one, the Apostles proclaim;
thee, O Virgin, the line of the Prophets sings;

lines.latin: Te Mártyres sui Dómini Matrem testántur.
lines.english: the Martyrs bear witness to thee, the Mother of their Lord.

lines.latin: Te per orbem terrárum sancta confitétur Ecclésia:
lines.english: Thee the holy Church throughout the world doth confess:
the Mother of boundless chastity;
the venerable Spouse of God, who knew not man;
who alone conceived by the Holy Ghost.
Thou art the Queen of heaven.
Thou art the Lady of the whole world.

lines.latin: Tu ad liberándum hóminem pérditum, carne vestísti Altíssimi Fílium.
lines.english: Thou, to set lost man free, didst clothe the Son of the Most High with flesh.

lines.latin: Tu ad vincéndum mortis acúleo, castíssimo protulísti vitam ex útero.
lines.english: Thou, to overcome the sting of death, didst bring forth Life from thy most chaste womb.

lines.latin: Tu ad déxteram Dei Patris sedéntis Fílii es Mater:
lines.english: Thou art the Mother of the Son who sitteth at the right hand of God the Father,

lines.latin: Judex vivórum qui est et mortuórum.
lines.english: who is the Judge of the living and of the dead.

lines.latin: Te ergo quǽsumus, Christi crédulis súbveni,
lines.english: We beseech thee, therefore, help those who believe in Christ,
redeemed by the most precious Fruit of thy womb.
Make them

lines.latin: cum Sanctis cunctis in glória munerári.
lines.english: to be rewarded with all the Saints in glory everlasting.
Save thy people, O Lady,
blessed and immaculate.
And rule them,

lines.latin: et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
lines.english: and lift them up for ever.
Every day we bless thee.

lines.latin: Et laudámus nomen Altíssimi, qui te fecit altíssimam.
lines.english: And we praise the name of the Most High, who made thee most high.

lines.latin: Dignáre omni laude digníssima, ab indigníssimis laudári.
lines.english: Vouchsafe, thou most worthy of all praise, to be praised by the most unworthy.
Have mercy on us, O Lady, Mother of mercy.

lines.latin: Fiat misericórdia Fílii tui Dómina super nos, ope tua qua clamámus ei.
lines.english: Let the mercy of thy Son, O Lady, be upon us, by thy help, as we cry to Him.
In thee, O Lady, have I hoped:
let me never be confounded.
